brief:
A Palestinian refugee and two relatives drowned off the English coast, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident occurred in waters near England's shoreline, claiming three lives in what authorities are treating as a fatal drowning. A girl from the family was rescued and transported to hospital, where she remains in critical condition following the incident.

Prime Minister Burnham characterized the deaths as a "terrible family tragedy." Emergency services responded to the drowning, conducting rescue operations that saved the surviving child. Authorities have not yet disclosed additional details about the circumstances surrounding the deaths or the hospitalized girl's condition.
dek: A girl is taken to hospital in critical condition in what PM Burnham calls a 'terrible family tragedy'.
title: Palestinian refugee and two relatives drown off English coast
